name: hud_layout_node_apply_meter_quad
description: HudUiLayoutNode::ApplyMeterQuad reads a meter layout rectangle, writes the source rect, applies base and optional offsets to quad points, stores fill height and width, and rejects non-array nodes.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD layout/bar/meter tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x413c10 validates reading left/top/right/bottom from payload[1..4], converting right and bottom to exclusive values before writing outRect, applying yBase to top/bottom and xBase to the right edge, applying optional offsetXY to left/top/right/bottom, writing four bar points through HudUiBar::SetPointXY, storing fillPixelsMax as height and meterFlags as width, and returning 1.

The native smoke verifies the accepted array path with base and offset arguments, the original outRect values, the resulting four point coordinates, draw vertex count, fill height, width field, and the non-array early return preserving target and outRect state.
